name: aibiz-community-building
description: Dùng khi mot CA NHAN muon xay CONG DONG quanh minh — Zalo Group, Telegram, Facebook Group, Skool, Mighty Networks, Discord: blueprint 3 lop public / member / inner, luong onboarding 7 ngay, nghi thuc tuong tac hang tuan, playbook kiem duyet, chi so kich hoat va cac loi thuong gap o VN. Kích hoạt khi người dùng nhắc 'xay cong dong', 'Zalo group', 'Facebook group rieng', 'Skool community', 'membership site', 'group im lang khong ai noi', 'gom nguoi theo doi vao mot cho'. Không dùng cho — kiem tien tu cong dong thi dung skill personal-brand-monetize; rai seeding duoi bai dang thi dung skill seeding-plan; giu chan khach da mua cua doanh nghiep thi dung skill giu-chan-khach-hang.
